notes:
v4.6.99 — IBKR bots survive a hung gateway (no more silent exits)

🛰️ ZOMBIE-GATEWAY GUARD
• A hung IB gateway still accepts the connection but its API is dead — every request times out and it reports no account. Bots that hit this ran blind or dropped out. Now the bot detects an unresponsive gateway and RETRIES every tick (staying alive) until a healthy gateway is up — for this bot and all future bots. Stacks on the earlier fix that bounds every gateway request with a timeout (no more hangs).

Note: equity bots (energy/breakout/day/long/short) only trade during US market hours (9:30am–4:00pm ET) — outside that they won't run.

Update via the in-app banner.
